reflection_preparation.interpretation: Fixed reflections of all three planes enlarge training only. No model score selects examples.

limitations: Per-truth localized support is an opportunity bound, not jointly attainable recall. Shared proposals and NMS can couple nearby truths.
Every original truth, including tiny and large markers, stays in the denominator. Diameter groups are diagnostic only.
This uses the existing complete-development decoder and saved outputs. It does not change thresholds, gates, masks or geometry.
Anchor relation uses the existing nearest-truth <=3 pixel rule; this is descriptive, not new labels.
Near-truth unmatched predictions can reflect duplication or matching competition; no runtime behavior changes.
Rendered diameter is a size descriptor, not proof that a point lies inside a particular glyph.
Contact sheet selection is descriptive only. All original cases and failures remain in aggregate counts.

cpu_budget.scope: Synchronous guarded work/rest average; not instantaneous per-core utilization

decision: Reject the fixed V37 fixed-reflection confidence candidate because it fails the unchanged shared development bars. Retain V44/English/V27/V5. The full native/CSV effects are preserved in the authenticated local audit. Do not activate or repeat this unchanged candidate.
license_review: Owned Apache-2.0 model, synthetic data and source. Existing reviewed OCR/classifier inputs remain checksum-bound. No dependency or imported weights added.
limitations: Equal per-row binary cross-entropy on an enriched training population does not prove calibration on native proposal populations.
Reflected text is a training augmentation, not a claim that all reflected typography occurs in real inputs.
Confidence ordering changes NMS and selected centers even with per-patch geometry frozen.
Raw accepted-set additions/removals can include numerical movement and are not recovered/lost truth counts; use paired truth measurements.
Synthetic metrics and validated rows do not establish real acceptance or the runtime safety property by themselves.
No private/sealed input access, production activation, packaged build or release. Goal22 remains incomplete.
